content: {"like":["Enjoys the original Alien films for their classic sci‑fi horror vibe","Prefers high‑energy action and emotional depth in superhero films like Wonder Woman","Values a polished, streamlined animation style in animated DC cartoons","Finds well‑executed, character‑driven drama in shows like House of Cards Season 5","Appreciates superhero movies that exceed expectations, such as Justice League"],"dislike":["Dislikes live‑action DC movies that fall short of their animated counterparts","Criticizes slower pacing in sci‑fi sequels, e.g., Alien: Covenant and Blade Runner 2049","Finds certain DC animated films lacking, like DCU: Batman & Harley Quinn","Disapproves of weaker seasons in long‑running dramas, e.g., House of Cards Season 3","Wishes for stronger character arcs, such as removing Paige from House of Cards"]}
